findings.location: Statement clause (b), definition of e_J^wedge; Facts & Assumptions [F2]; Proof step 1.2.
findings.evidence: The antisymmetrized basis-vector formula uses sigma(1),...,sigma(n) and the action formula uses pi-inverse(1),...,pi-inverse(n), but the cited S_n has domain {0,...,n-1}. The resulting tuple entries can have index 0 although the factor tuple is indexed 1 through n.

The sum over pi in S_N forms e_{j_{pi(1)}} tensor through e_{j_{pi(N)}} although the cited permutation group acts on {0,...,N-1}. Some resulting subscripts are 0, outside the tuple j_1,...,j_N; no shifted action is defined.
